subject: distsql: use a more accurate type of the context of distsql (#51618)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent, scoped to executor/planner/session/sessionctx. The change is a refactor to pass a per-statement cached `*distsqlctx.DistSQLContext` into DistSQL request building/execution instead of using `StmtCtx`/`SessionVars` directly; no remaining Blocker/High issues were found after checking later history (the only plausible cache-staleness risk was addressed later on upstream/master).
